notes_for_editor: The websiteservice.ca towermen list loses its label-to-value order in text extraction, so names, years and tower lists were matched entry by entry from the page layout; check George Roberts (1970-1981) and Sam Roberts (1970-1989) against the page, since both overlap at Thunder Mountain. A later block on the same list reads '2007-9 Anglin - Thunder Mountain' under a name that could not be tied to it, so it is not used. An Urban Exploration Resource forum thread on Saskatchewan towers mentions a 2015 fire near Thunder Mountain and the tower being fenced off in 2016, but uer.ca returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text, so nothing from it is cited. No source fetched gives the tower's height, status, access or fate, so those remain unknown. The brief's agency (Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency) is not named in any fetched page.
